snippet.title: Space Strike
snippet.description:
http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/3419/space-strike/index.html

Destroy an onslaught of menacing aliens before they kill mankind. The year is 2307 and you have a recon mission in your region. Assume the role of a spaceship pilot and unleash the fury of an awesome high-tech arsenal that includes: impulse guns, quantum lasers, heat-seeking missiles, and much more. Enjoy intense combat action in this nimble Space Strike Shooter-style game.

 * Space Shooter game
 * 20 challenging missions
 * 5 landscape types

Download and play more great Arcade Games at http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/genres/1/action-arcade.html
